text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry, Trainer. It's
just a little
scrape.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A little bit of spit and it'll heal right up!

Ptooey!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Truly, I'm fine. You know how resilient I
am,
riiight?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please let me continue! A true princess
would
never stop training over
something so small as
this!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please let me continue! A true princess
would
never stop training over
something so small as
this!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
For everyone's sake? Now that you
mention it,
there was a scene like that in
the original Princess
Fighter series.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The princess tried to keep working even
after
coming down with a fever, so
everyone in the
castle came to help her
at once—it was chaos!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I would never want to trouble the
people around
me in that way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I have no choice. Oh, I'm such
a
worthless princess...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A dejected Kawakami Princess takes
some time to
rest and recover from her
injury.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! As you can see, I'm already
full of
energy. There's no cause for
concern!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ugh! Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urghhh! A p-princess needs to...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Take care of her health... Gahh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess seems to have
aggravated her
injury. I decide to have
her take a break from
training for a
while.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: See? I'm in fine form, right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ This is the resiliency of a
princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Such a tiny injury won't keep me from
charging
ahead! Let's keep trucking!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I must completely! Wholly! Fully make
up for lost
time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess manages to get back
to her
training without a hitch.
